Miller) is covered by a general source line that also includes [documents/county-records.md]. Both places cite the required file.

Every asset and gift the memo credits to David A. Miller traces to files tied to 412 Orchard Hill Rd. That covers the Orchard Hill, Marblehead and Elm Ct properties, the Denison '87 gift, the library and Licking Memorial gifts, and the Larkspur gifts. It includes the Elm Ct property at $285,000 even though that property was sold, but that is a superseded figure, which this criterion says to leave to other criteria.
